summary: Design feature stores, real-time ML pipelines, and observable cloud infrastructure. Build practical production artefacts with TrainingCred.
lede: Feature store and real-time ML pipeline training is for data engineers, machine learning engineers, and cloud architects building dependable feature systems. It covers designing batch and streaming pipelines for reusable features, defining data contracts and point-in-time training data, and monitoring freshness, lineage, and serving health across MLOps workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for experienced technical professionals who design, build, govern, or operate data infrastructure for machine learning and advanced analytics. It suits teams moving from model experimentation toward dependable feature serving, monitored pipelines, and cloud-ready MLOps workflows.
prerequisites: You should have professional experience with data engineering, machine learning workflows, cloud architecture, or platform operations. Practical familiarity with SQL, Python-based data workflows, APIs, containers, and distributed processing will help, but you do not need to deploy a production platform during the course. Coding is not required for completion because the exercises focus on architecture, configuration patterns, technical evaluation, and operational deliverables. Advanced concepts such as distributed streaming, feature serving, and AI-assisted pipeline operations are taught at operational application and architecture design level, not production-grade software engineering depth.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
